card.name: Decimal point in section cross-references
card.fires_on: The period (or the space just before the number) inside a section reference such as (7.1) or (2.4) in the highlights of a drug label. It fires most on the dot after section 2 or 7.

modes.label: Dot in section number
modes.description: The period between the chapter and subsection digits in a parenthesized label cross-reference.

modes.label: Space after open parenthesis
modes.description: The space right after the opening parenthesis, just before a section number.

card.plain: It marks the point inside a section number like 2.1 or 7.1 that cites another part of the drug label.
